relationship_coverage.coverage_summary: overview shows all 8 components and all 8 relations in one layout; seams repeats R1, R2, R3, R8 with room between the two opposite gRPC edges; execution repeats R4, R5, R6, R7 with no backward edge. Every one of the 8 relations is visible in at least two views, and nothing is dropped, reversed, or relabelled.
deliberate_abstractions: modal-daemon is placed in the same layer as Container backend and Filesystem + volumes because its only relation is runtime → daemon; layer position expresses 'adjacent to the storage layer', not a claim of physical co-location.

Edge labels are shortened to fit 14-character slots (task input + control RPCs → 'control gRPC'; events + management RPCs → 'events gRPC'; dispatches tasks → 'task dispatch'; runs the user process → 'runs process'; mounts / snapshots → 'mount/snapshot'; image + volume data → 'image/vol data'; filesystem HTTP over UDS → 'fs HTTP over UDS'). Abbreviations are expanded below.

known_defects.what: The two RPC labels share one render row: overview line 11 reads '│ control gRPC│ events gRPC', seams line 20 the same.
known_defects.why: Router picks the nearest free slot; each label sits immediately right of its own stem (control gRPC right of the down stem at col 12/25, events gRPC right of the return corridor at col 27/40).
known_defects.impact: Attribution is correct but must be confirmed by following each stem; a reader could mistake the neighbouring bar for a delimiter.
known_defects.attempted_fix: overview v2 (edge order) and seams v2 (lr) — neither removed it; lr also overflowed the pane.

known_defects.what: 'starts/manages' is printed on the arrowhead row, between the two arrowheads (overview line 30 cols 14-27; execution line 22 cols 23-36).
known_defects.impact: It belongs to engine→backend (the left arrow) but sits between two arrowheads, so a hasty reader could attach it to engine→filesystem.
known_defects.attempted_fix: execution v2 (swapped layer order) moves the label but reproduces the same row-of-arrowheads placement.
